title: Odd Even Linked List
description:
Given the `head` of a singly linked list, group all nodes positioned at **odd 1-based indices** together followed by the nodes positioned at **even 1-based indices**, and return the reordered list.

The relative order inside both the odd group and the even group must remain identical to the input. Solve the problem in `O(n)` time and `O(1)` extra space.
constraints: The number of nodes in the list is in the range [0, 10^4].
hints: Maintain two running tail pointers `odd` (starting at `head`) and `even` (starting at `head.next`), and save `evenHead = even`.
In each step link `odd.next = even.next`, advance `odd`, link `even.next = odd.next`, and advance `even`; finally connect `odd.next = evenHead`.

examples.explanation: Odd-indexed nodes [1, 3, 5] come first, followed by even-indexed nodes [2, 4].
